paper_title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
core_problem: Enabling Large Language Models to accurately call massive numbers of APIs with constraints while reducing hallucinations and staying updated with API changes.
methodology_summary: Gorilla uses LLaMA fine-tuning combined with retriever-aware training on APIBench, a dataset constructed from TorchHub, TensorHub, and HuggingFace API documentations. It evaluates model outputs using AST sub-tree matching to verify API functionality and argument correctness under constraints.
empirical_results: Gorilla significantly outperforms GPT-4 in API functionality accuracy and reduces hallucination across zero-shot and retriever-integrated settings.
explicit_limitations: Evaluating API calls via direct code execution output is not fully realized in this benchmark (left for future work), and static test cases fall short for evaluating complex, nuanced API calls with overlapping functionality.
